object: Austrian physicist (1887–1961). Nobel Prize 1933. Formulated the wave equation (1926) that gave quantum mechanics its continuous mathematical framework. Sided with Einstein against Copenhagen. Later devised the cat thought experiment to expose what he saw as the absurdity of quantum superposition taken literally.
